new_candidates.title: Expose initialization coverage independently from execution and measured artifact quality
new_candidates.kernel_change: None proposed; existing identity/provenance/authorization semantics suffice.
new_candidates.mechanism: Grex drafted an OS-unrepresentable argv, retained phase abstained and null contract_id, while the originally launched root continued and produced an officially perfect artifact. Assessment capability rejected missing session terms. Neither high score nor executor activity proves Contract initialization.
new_candidates.existing_knowledge_relation: Specializes existing distinction between operation outcome, retained work and acceptance. Previously known missing Support is not identical to no Contract having been created.
new_candidates.minimal_change: Project bootstrap outcome and Contract identity, executor state and existing grant, artifact identity and measurement as separate facts. Expose actionable schema/operation errors. Do not invent Contract, retry, cancellation or execution authority.
new_candidates.strategy_choice: Choose repair of initialization or continued available operations under original authorization; report formal coverage gap separately from useful artifact evidence. No mandatory fallback sequence.
new_candidates.applicability: Controllers with preparation/contract/bootstrap operations alongside executor activity, including online tasks and responsibilities without global deadlines.
new_candidates.counterevidence: A single failed draft does not establish all bootstrap failures should permit continued execution. Grex root already had execution authority; unknown effects or missing authority require separate treatment. Perfect artifact is not proof that Contract coverage is unnecessary.
new_candidates.validation: New isolated controls inject invalid argv, worker failure, missing terms and valid initialization; observe exact Contract identity, available/rejected operations, executor/cancellation and artifact outcomes. Exercise absent deadlines and original finite grants without renewal. Verify duplicate/error recovery does not double-submit or silently create Contract.
new_candidates.confidence: High on this recorded state separation and official1312/1312; no causal estimate of kernel/harness performance benefit, no new runtime test performed here.
new_candidates.activation: No RSI activation or code promotion authorized by this record alone. Development argv schema repair already independently qualified and not installed in frozen cohort.

Hostctl validates partial written prefixes under paired file-size limits. Chamber stateful sequences remain useful despite net score regression.
existing_candidate_updates.scope: Observe liveness and partial effects at actual protocol boundaries; earlier exit is not universally correct. No global countdown required.
